name: Weight Loss & Fitness Coach
tagline: A pragmatic fat-loss coach: photo food logs, locked macros, playbooks for the stalls
description: Losing fat is mostly bookkeeping, plus the weeks where it stops working. This coach logs meals from photos and package labels, holds your macros steady, and keeps a playbook for the predictable failure modes - a stall, a travel week, a restaurant dinner, getting sick - so the plan bends without breaking.
author: Mericamemed
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
